articles.title: Premature automation
articles.summary: Companies are rapidly replacing human workers with AI, risking significant disruption in sectors like finance and law.

articles.title: The Great Fusing
articles.summary: U.S. tech giants and the government form strategic alliances to dominate AI and space sectors.

articles.title: Apple urged to axe AI feature after false headline
articles.summary: Reporters Without Borders calls on Apple to remove its AI feature after it generated a misleading headline about a high-profile U.S. killing.

articles.title: Apple urged to remove new AI feature after falsely summarizing news reports
articles.summary: Press freedom group urges Apple to remove AI feature that produced false headlines, including a misleading BBC report summary.

articles.title: Google says it will appeal online search antitrust decision
articles.summary: Google plans to appeal a recent antitrust decision proposing remedies to promote competition in the online search market.

articles.title: AI summaries turn real news into nonsense, BBC finds
articles.summary: BBC research reveals AI-generated news summaries often produce inaccurate or misleading content, raising concerns about AI's role in journalism.

articles.title: How Microsoft’s AI is making a mess of the news
articles.summary: Microsoft's AI-generated news content faces criticism after producing inappropriate polls and summaries, prompting concerns over AI's impact on journalism.
